lead: A test that drives an accept loop must loop on `report.parked` rather than call `nvs_host::run_until_idle` once.
body: That call returns the moment one blocking poll wakes nothing, and readiness collected for a task that has already ended is the ordinary way that happens — so a core that is still accepting stops at whichever stale wake came first, leaving the client with no answer and no end of file. It fails on windows-x86_64 and passes on the other legs; drive with `serve.rs`'s `run_the_core`, which is `nvs-cli`'s worker loop with a deadline on it.
